//: Loaded ONLY when ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Development (the default when running from Visual Studio / dotnet run locally). It overrides appsettings.json for local development and is NOT used in Azure, so production stays on Azure SQL + SSO. Adjust ConnectionStrings:DefaultConnection to your local SQL instance.
//Database: Local SQL Server instead of Azure SQL. Trusted_Connection uses Windows auth (no password). If your local SQL uses a named instance or SQL auth, change the server / add User Id + Password (put any password in the gitignored appsettings.Local.json, not here).
//ActiveDirectory: Off locally — the on-prem DC (tsdc01.domain.local) is unreachable from a dev machine; sign in against the Users table instead.
//Auth: Local username/password sign-in (SSO off) plus the one-click dev-login. Sign in with the seeded DefaultAdmin (admin / Admin@12345) or open /account/dev-login.
//BlobStorage: Store uploaded files in the database locally (no Azure Blob).
//Email: No Graph/SMTP locally. In Development the OTP code is surfaced on-screen instead of emailed, so self-service verification works without a mail server.
//Deployment: Internal = full app + local DB + built-in self-service at /supplier/self-service/{token} (no separate API/DMZ needed locally).
